title: On Entering the hall without knocking
subtitle: 竞技体育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 竞技体育（文学艺术与体育·竞技体育与赛事）
meta: 主题语境：竞技体育（文学艺术与体育·竞技体育与赛事）　|　核心词汇：enter　|　正文 347 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 enter 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1956 the coach ① entered the hall without knocking without a word of thanks, and every player in the field said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the coach ② enters the hall without knocking at once without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ enter the hall without knocking at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ entered the hall without knocking before — a line in the record for April 1950 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Entering the hall without knocking without a word of thanks, the coach said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the whistle at the far stand, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ enter the youngest boy for the race at once, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Enter the youngest boy for the race at once and never mention it again.

By 1963 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the record, and a new player from the next field ⑧ enters the youngest boy for the race without a word of thanks every season without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the stand, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ entered the hall without knocking again when nobody else would.

⑩ To enter the hall without knocking, my mother said in 1968, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the field remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the field forgets, somebody enters the hall without knocking at once again and somebody must enter the hall without knocking without a word of thanks all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 进入（一般过去式 entered the hall without knocking：1956 年教练头一回这样做，不图一句谢）
B. v. 进入（一般现在 enters the hall without knocking：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 进入（不定式 to enter the hall without knocking：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 进入（过去完成时 had entered the hall without knocking：1950 年四月的赛事记录上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 进入（动名词 entering the hall without knocking 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 报名参加（enter the youngest boy for the race：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去报名参加给最小的男孩报了赛跑）
G. v. 报名参加（enter the youngest boy for the race：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 进入（后段两处：新来的队员照例 enters the youngest boy for the race，而母亲又一次 entered the hall without knocking）

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 enter 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1956 the coach entered the hall without knocking without a word of thanks, and nobody in the field forgot it.
Even now the coach enters the hall without knocking at once whenever the field asks.
Entering the hall without knocking without a word of thanks, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever enter the youngest boy for the race at once, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new player from the next field enters the youngest boy for the race without a word of thanks every season, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother entered the hall without knocking again, and the field remembered that half.
